name: flowboard
description: FlowBoard — Collaborative Project & Task Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@flowboard/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@flowboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@flowboard/shared && npm run build --workspace=@flowboard/api && npm run build --workspace=@flowboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@flowboard/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flowboard/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flowboard/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@flowboard/api && npm run lint --workspace=@flowboard/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@flowboard/api && npm run test --workspace=@flowboard/web
